# Requirements Quality Checklist: Product List Filters

**Purpose**: Review the completeness, clarity, consistency, and measurable quality of the product-list and filter requirements.
**Created**: 2026-10-14
**Feature**: [../spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are the supported product attributes, price boundaries, availability values, and category/subcategory filter options fully enumerated? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003–005, §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK002 Are pagination or incremental-loading requirements defined, including how changing filters affects the current page/cursor? [Gap, Spec §FR-005, §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK003 Are requirements defined for loading, retry, empty results, and partial/stale filter metadata? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK004 Are product card information and accessible navigation requirements specified for all returned product entries? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK005 Is the URL query-parameter schema defined, including names, serialization of ranges, defaults, and canonical handling of repeated or malformed values? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK006 Are price-range boundary semantics defined, including inclusivity, currency, decimal precision, and behavior when minimum exceeds maximum? [Gap, Spec §FR-004, §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK007 Are “relevance” and “newest” sorting defined by explicit ranking/date rules and stable tie-breakers? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the intended behavior for stale or unavailable filter values consistent between clearing, explaining, and ignoring the selection? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-012]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK009 Are filter AND semantics and single category/subcategory selection consistent with chips, URL state, and result-count behavior? [Consistency, Spec §Story 2–4, §FR-005–009, §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK010 Are the default sort behavior and sort persistence consistent when clearing all filters versus removing one chip? [Consistency, Spec §Story 4, §Edge Cases, §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK011 Are mobile filter-panel requirements consistent with preserving selections, exposing result counts, and returning to product results? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002, §Edge Cases]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK012 Can the matching-product count and product correctness criteria be measured over the full result set rather than only the visible page? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK013 Are usability time targets and mobile-screen success targets defined with participant, viewport, and measurement conditions? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001, §SC-005]

## Scenario and Edge-Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK014 Are transitions among parent category, dependent subcategory, stale selection, and no-subcategory states fully specified? [Coverage, Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-003, §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK015 Are browser back/forward, refresh, shared URL, and rapid filter changes addressed as distinct history and response-order scenarios? [Coverage, Spec §Story 3, §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK016 Are currency changes, unavailable product transitions, and data-service failures distinguished from legitimate zero-result responses? [Coverage, Exception Flow, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-013]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK017 Are responsive breakpoint expectations and the behavior of the mobile filter panel defined sufficiently to assess overflow and content obstruction? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001, §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK018 Are accessible selected-state announcements, chip-removal names, focus restoration, and result-update announcements covered? [Gap, Spec §FR-014]

## Dependencies, Assumptions, and Ambiguities

- [ ] CHK019 Are Catalog ownership and the source of truth for product price, category, availability, and newest-date fields documented? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK020 Are assumptions about initial filter state, default sort, result page size, and filter option availability validated or explicitly left open? [Assumption, Spec §FR-004, §Assumptions]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
